in_marathi.name: Geetleen
in_marathi.long_meaning: Geetleen हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Geetleen is derived from the Sanskrit words 'geeta' meaning song, melody and 'leena' meaning rule, control. This name signifies a melodious and rule-abiding girl.
